summary: A bass synth firmware for DnB, dub, dubstep and techno, with wobble, reese, sub and 808 sounds, a morph between sounds and a built-in drum sequencer. Marked beta.
features: 9 oscillator engines incl. 808, 4-op FM, growl, additive, hard sync
Three LFOs with one-gesture 'LFO learn' assignment
A/B morph and FX pads on the keys
64-step bass sequencer with probability and trig conditions
8-track drum sequencer with p-locks, automation and sync out
Sample oscillator, arpeggiator, MIDI; English, French or Spanish menus
